name: x402-wallet
display_name: x402 Wallet by 402.md — USDC Payments for AI Agents
description: Minimal x402 wallet for Claude. Check USDC balance and sign payments on Stellar, Base, or Solana — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude a USDC wallet. This extension adds three tools:

- **check_balance** — View your USDC balance and wallet address
- **pay** — Sign an x402 payment authorization (USDC on Stellar, Base, or Solana)
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a URL with automatic x402 payment handling

Supports the x402 "exact" scheme plus the EVM "upto" scheme (authorize a maximum, pay for actual usage — ideal for metered APIs) and "auth-capture" scheme (authorize a hold, server captures later). Payments on Solana are gasless — the facilitator pays the fees. Supports the payment-identifier extension for idempotent retries.

Claude handles everything else — discovering skills, reading SKILL.md docs, calling APIs. The wallet just signs payments when needed.

Budget limits protect your funds: set max per call and max per day.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Sign an x402 USDC payment authorization (exact, upto, or auth-capture scheme). Returns the X-PAYMENT header value.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL with automatic x402 payment (exact, upto, or auth-capture scheme). Handles 402 responses by signing USDC payment and retrying with X-PAYMENT header.
